dogecoin.text: @ItsDogeCoin I bought my first #Dogecoin last week at $.48. I'm not a wealthy fella. I'm a southern blue collar trade skill worker. Its my first personal investment and I've got about 3500 shares. I joined Twitter just for the amazing #dogecoin community. I'm buying this #dogetothemoon stuff.
